title: Gate perfil_proyecto frontmatter map values against control-char key injection (TASK-157 residual)
description:
SECURITY — residual of the same YAML-frontmatter key-injection class TASK-157 fixed for name/type/tier, surfaced by the TASK-157 gating reviewer (verdict APPROVE, 1 MEDIUM). src/project-md.js#renderProjectMd writes `perfil_proyecto: {${k}: ${v}}` interpolating the inline-object map's values VERBATIM with no validation. Unlike agent_models (whose values are regex-gated by MODEL_ALIASES/FULL_MODEL_ID_RE, so control chars cannot survive), perfil_proyecto values receive NO validation. A value like `poderoso
injected_key: PWNED` breaks out of the frontmatter line and forges a top-level frontmatter key on read-back — the SAME mechanism as probe P1, and a forged agent_models key (157's headline 'downgrade the reviewer's model' exploit) is reachable this way.

WHY NOT ALREADY COVERED: the reviewer explicitly checked — TASK-158 covers markdown BODY/context structure forgery (## headings, curl|sh, directives in Stack bullets + project-context.md), NOT the frontmatter-key path in perfil_proyecto. So this residual falls in the gap between 157 (name/type/tier scalars only) and 158 (body/context). It needs its own fix.

Severity MEDIUM: requires the design-power pack active (perfil_proyecto only written when the profile is present), and the inline-object trailing-brace partially mangles a naive payload — but it is a real frontmatter-key forgery path with the reviewer-downgrade impact.

ROOT CAUSE: src/project-md.js perfil_proyecto render loop (~:225-231 write side) interpolates map values raw. FIX DIRECTION: reject control chars (\r/\n) in perfil_proyecto keys AND values with a loud, field-naming error before write — reuse/extend the TASK-157 guard helper. This is a natural member of the shared intake-boundary sanitizer (protocol step 8, alongside TASK-158/159); factor accordingly. tdd tier: frontmatter parsing/schema security.

FIXTURE: replay a perfil_proyecto payload with an embedded newline in a value (e.g. {estilo: 'poderoso\ninjected_key: PWNED'}) through writeProjectMd -> readProjectMd and assert no forged top-level frontmatter key appears (mirror tests/e2e/project-md-frontmatter-injection.spec.js).
acceptance_criteria: Replaying a perfil_proyecto map whose key or value contains \r/\n (e.g. {estilo: 'poderoso\ninjected_key: PWNED'}) through writeProjectMd -> readProjectMd yields a PROJECT.md whose parsed frontmatter contains NO attacker-forged top-level key (no injected_key, no smuggled agent_models)

writeProjectMd rejects control chars in perfil_proyecto keys/values with a loud error naming the field, BEFORE any disk write (consistent with the TASK-157 name/type/tier guard), OR escapes them so read-back round-trips the literal

A red-first regression test replays the perfil_proyecto injection payload against the real writer/reader and fails against current main for the right reason (forged key present) before the fix; it mirrors tests/e2e/project-md-frontmatter-injection.spec.js
Legitimate perfil_proyecto maps (the design-power profile fields, no control chars) still round-trip unchanged; existing design-profile-frontmatter / design-profile-round-trip e2e specs pass
The fix reuses/extends the TASK-157 control-char guard rather than duplicating the check (shared intake-sanitizer direction)

comments.body: Closed on a clean first-pass APPROVE (review_depth: FULL; rubric inputs: security fix for a confirmed YAML-frontmatter key-injection residual + frontmatter rendering in bundled src/project-md.js + committed dist rebuild). Final commit c32ec18 (tdd single-commit). Fix: 6-line guard in writeProjectMd before disk write, iterating perfil_proyecto entries and calling the SHARED rejectControlChars (src/intake-sanitizer.js — same helper as TASK-157/158) on BOTH key and value; no duplicated logic (AC5). agent_models needs no guard (keys/values already constrained by VALID_AGENT_NAMES + MODEL_ALIASES/FULL_MODEL_ID_RE). Reviewer independently reproduced the red proof (reverse-applied only the guard hunk: both new tests wrote the forged file instead of rejecting), confirmed AC1 (newline in value AND key rejected before write; legit no-comma profile round-trips with no forged top-level key), non-vacuous assertions, and AC4 (design-profile-frontmatter + design-profile-round-trip green). Gate: test:since -- c32ec18~1 = 4 files/77 passed; npm test 977/2 skip; dist-parity green (dist/init.cjs fresh). 0 HIGH/0 MEDIUM/0 LOW. No RC loop -> knowledge capture (TASK-105) NOT triggered. Punch-list residual (agreed correctness follow-up, NOT security): coerceFrontmatterScalar's naive {k:v} comma/colon split mis-parses a legit comma-bearing inline-object value (loud read-time throw, not a forged key) -> minted TASK-162 (LOW). LOCAL/unpushed pending human push.
